messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PD-2456 fired — priority=P3 — inference-proxy latency spike detected in us-west-2. alert: https://pagerduty.example/PD-2456
maya: taking first touch, pinging SRE rotation. checking dashboards now.
jason: ack — joining the thread. any customer errors showing?
maya: no 5xx spikes in traces, mostly elevated proxy/router tail latency for a small traffic slice. 95p went from ~1.2s -> ~4.8s. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/board/latency (short link)
sylvia: I see repeated synthetic canary hits at 15:54 UTC, 3 quick flares. looks like scheduler overlap + bursty prefills. pulling autoscaler logs.
kevin: log snip: ```router serve req id=a1b2c3 latency=4.9s region=us-west-2 route=/v1/generate model=gpt-xl kv_cache_miss=1```
incident-bot: PD-2456 acknowledged by maya. escalation policy -> oncall-r2 then lead-sre after 5m.
maya: handing to jason — I'll stay available but going to triage the canary config. opening runbook: /runbooks/latency-hotfix
jason: taking lead. if this is synthetic-only and no customer impact, I'll mute noisy PD and pause the offending canary. paste canary IDs?
sylvia: canary IDs: synth-zw-7, synth-zw-8. matches scheduler overlap window. I'm going to roll back the scheduler tweak for synths and watch.
kevin: applied temp throttle to synth scheduler: `kubectl patch cronjob synth -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'` — will unpause after validation.
incident-bot: PD-2456 auto-resolved (alert returned to normal) — resolution timestamp 4776510301.
maya: metrics confirming baseline — 95p back ~1.1s, no customer-facing errors in logs. good to close.
jason: thanks — follow-up: i'll draft a short note for #postmortems with action items: (1) schedule canary runs to avoid overlap, (2) add a small cooldown in scheduler, (3) improve runbook steps for noisy synthetic alerts.
oncall-r2: :white_check_mark: appreciated. leaving this thread in case we need further follow-up.
